Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)

Required findings: Greater than six (6) months since the prior cervical decompression or cervical fusion at an adjacent level

Symptoms include BOTH significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.) AND unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability

Physical exam findings include ANY of the following: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor deficit (e.g., biceps, triceps weakness), reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, nerve root tension sign (e.g., Spurling's maneuver), or unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity without concordant objective physical exam findings

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for six (6) weeks; provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for six (6) weeks; or epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery

Plain x-rays of the cervical spine (including flexion/extension lateral views) and advanced diagnostic imaging show successful decompression and fusion at the previous operative level; MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings and that is caused by ANY of the following: herniated disc(s) (retained disc material or a recurrent disc herniation), synovial cyst or arachnoid cyst, central/lateral/foraminal stenosis, or osteophytes

Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders) AND documentation of nicotine-free status with EITHER individual is a never-smoker OR individual has refrained from smoking, use of smokeless tobacco products, and/or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.7: Adjacent Segment Disease > Radiculopathy (TOC: S12.1.1)

Required findings: Symptoms include ANY of the following: upper/lower extremity weakness, numbness, or pain; fine motor dysfunction (buttoning, handwriting, clumsiness of hands); gait disturbance; new-onset bowel or bladder dysfunction; or frequent falls

Physical exam findings include ANY of the following: grip and release test, ataxic gait, hyperreflexia, Hoffmann sign, Babinski sign, tandem walking test demonstrating ataxia, inverted brachial radial reflex, increased muscle tone or spasticity, clonus, or myelopathic hand
MRI/CT shows findings that are concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings and that are caused by EITHER cervical spinal cord compression or cervical spinal stenosis
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.7: Adjacent Segment Disease > Myelopathy (TOC: S12.1.2)

Non-Indications: ACDF for a degenerative spinal segment adjacent to a previous decompression or fusion procedure performed less than six (6) months after the prior surgery

Radiculopathy cases where the patient has not demonstrated less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least two of the required conservative management options (analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs for 6 weeks, provider-directed exercise for 6 weeks, or epidural steroid injection/selective nerve root block at the same level)
Cases where imaging does not show successful decompression and fusion at the previous operative level
Cases where MRI/CT does not show neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings
Cases with unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)

Cases where the patient is not a never-smoker and has not refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery, or where objective cotinine testing is not verified as within the normal range
Myelopathy cases where MRI/CT findings are not concordant with symptoms and physical exam findings, or are not caused by cervical spinal cord compression or cervical spinal stenosis
Important criteria & exceptions: Conservative management requirements for radiculopathy are waived if contraindicated

Nicotine-free status must be validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed, unless the individual is a never-smoker

For radiculopathy, conservative management must include at least TWO of the specified options, each for the required duration (6 weeks for medications/exercise, or performed at the same level for injections)
Documentation required: Plain x-rays of the cervical spine including flexion/extension lateral views
Advanced diagnostic imaging (MRI/CT) showing successful decompression and fusion at the previous operative level
MRI/CT showing neural structure compression at the requested level(s) concordant with symptoms and physical exam findings
Documentation of conservative management including prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs for six (6) weeks
Documentation of provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for six (6) weeks
Documentation of epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery

Documentation of nicotine-free status including never-smoker status or objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed
Documentation of absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders
